title: Young Man Relaxing by Lush Ivy Arbor, 1929 Minneapolis Vintage Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription:
DEC 4 1929
BROWN
Photo Service
Minneapolis, Minn.
description: A vintage snapshot capturing a young man seated outdoors in a sunlit garden setting, leaning back against a wall or arbor draped with dense, creeping ivy vines. He wears a light collared shirt and dark trousers, resting amid low hedges and dappled shade. The reverse side features a stamp from 'Brown Photo Service' in Minneapolis, Minnesota, dated December 4, 1929, likely printed from a negative exposed during the late summer or early fall of that year.
